definitions.explanation: Capable of catching fire and burning. Used as a prefix or modifier for materials, waste, and substances.

examples.japanese: {可燃|かねん}ごみ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火曜日|かようび}→火曜日：00640_kayoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Combustible garbage is put out on Tuesdays.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{倉庫|そうこ}→倉庫：04044_souko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{可燃|かねん}{物|ぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{火気|かき}{厳禁|げんきん}→火気厳禁：20397_kakigenkin⟧だ。
examples.english: This warehouse has many flammable materials, so open flames are strictly prohibited.

examples.japanese: {可燃|かねん}ごみ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{不燃|ふねん}ごみ→不燃ごみ：09536_funengomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}しく→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧⟦{分別|ぶんべつ}→分別：07706_bunbetsu⟧⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{回収|かいしゅう}して→回収する：21142_kaishuusuru⟧⟦もらえない→もらう：00520_morau⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you don't properly sort combustible and non-combustible garbage, it may not be collected.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in the compound {可燃|かねん}ごみ (combustible garbage/waste), which every resident in Japan needs to know for trash sorting. Composed of {可|か} (possible) and {燃|ねん} (burn).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可燃|かねん}ごみ — combustible garbage
- {可燃|かねん}{物|ぶつ} — flammable materials
- {可燃|かねん}{性|せい}⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧ — flammable gas
- {可燃|かねん}{性|せい}⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧ — flammable liquid

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不燃|ふねん} — non-flammable, non-combustible (its antonym; ⟦{不燃|ふねん}ごみ→不燃ごみ：09536_funengomi⟧ = non-combustible garbage)
- ⟦{燃|も}える→燃える：02312_moeru⟧⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ — burnable garbage (colloquial equivalent of {可燃|かねん}ごみ)
- {引火性|いんかせい} — ignitable; flash point (more technical; describes ease of ignition)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan's garbage sorting system requires residents to separate trash into categories including {可燃|かねん}ごみ (combustible), ⟦{不燃|ふねん}ごみ→不燃ごみ：09536_funengomi⟧ (non-combustible), ⟦{資源|しげん}ごみ→資源ごみ：09537_shigengomi⟧ (recyclable), and {粗大|そだい}⟦ごみ→ゴミ：00840_gomi⟧ (oversized items). Collection days and rules vary by municipality.
